question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched authority as CCP General Secretary, Central Military Commission chairman, and state president underpins the 95.8% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Recent military leadership purges and Politburo personnel changes through mid-2026 have reinforced rather than undermined his position by sidelining disloyal elements and ensuring elite alignment ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Leadership transitions in China historically align with scheduled party congresses rather than abrupt ousters, with no verified factional challenges, health signals, or policy disruptions emerging in the past year. Realistic scenarios that could still shift odds include a sudden medical event, an acute economic crisis prompting elite consensus for change, or a major external shock eroding internal cohesion before year-end.
